Direct shear test on RS soil (Red Crushed Volcanic Scoria (narrowly graded)), loose; apparatus: direct shear (University of Notre Dame). Recorded: peak shear strength vs normal stress with least-squares line (Univac 1107, CAL-COMP plot).

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The numbers below were digitized from the published figure by two readings made separately; they agree within the stated reading bounds at 17 of the 19 points, and the rest were settled against the scan. They have not yet been checked by a person. The test setup is incomplete: relative density Dr, specimen height, normal stress, held constant, displacement rate are not reported.
:::

## Data

![shear strength (peak shear stress) against normal stress, SI units. Error bars are reading bounds (half-widths from the digitization), not standard deviations. Filled markers were agreed by both readings, hollow ones were not.](../img/plots/b68-ds-fc-8.png){.lightbox}

Peak shear strength (peak shear stress) 190.9 kPa at 223.6 kPa normal stress, the end of the record.

Download: [observations.csv](../files/data/experiments/b68-ds-fc-8/observations.csv) (19 points: 6 plotted symbols, 10 samples of the drawn curve; columns `x_si`, `y_si` with bounds `x_bound_si`, `y_bound_si`; panel 1: shear strength (peak shear stress) in Pa against normal stress in Pa; the printed-unit values, the pixel position on the scan and the review status of each point are kept in further columns) and [series.json](../files/data/experiments/b68-ds-fc-8/series.json) (units, conversion factors, how the points were read).

Reading bounds on this figure (how far our reading of the printed figure may be off, not the uncertainty of the test): typical bound 322 Pa in normal stress, 1.4 kPa in shear strength (0.7 percent of the peak). Both independent readings agree within these bounds at 17 of the 19 points; the other 2 were settled against the scan (read by one reader and verified by the other, or decided between two readings). [Check the digitized points against the scan](../figures/index.qmd#check-fc-8).
